project_info.theme: Retail activation render for Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid launch
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Soft Peach Pink, Warm Sand, White, Beige, Matte Black

main_subject.detail: A wide 3D launch-event render showing a Cocoon branded retail installation for Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid, with curved product shelves, two oversized product bottles on a pedestal, educational panels, and event text announcing the launch at Van Hanh Mall from 10.07 to 12.07.2026.
main_subject.style: Polished commercial event render, immersive retail booth visualization, pastel brand experience design

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'VẠN HẠNH MALL TP. HỒ CHÍ MINH', 'SỰ KIỆN RA MẮT SỮA CHỐNG NẮNG VÔ CƠ SEN HẬU GIANG', '10.07 - 12.07.2026', 'BROAD SPECTRUM', 'SPF 50+', 'TONE-UP', 'BEIGE', and 'the cocoon ORIGINAL VIETNAM'.
items: Top Left: Venue text 'VẠN HẠNH MALL TP. HỒ CHÍ MINH'.
Bottom Left: Series of tall educational display panels showing campaign visuals, charts, and product education content.
Bottom Right: Curved circular product shelves filled with many sunscreen bottles, plus a Cocoon logo plinth and pastel brand wall.
Center/Background: Two oversized sunscreen bottles on a round pedestal, pastel sky-to-peach backdrop, sandy chip flooring, and sparse decorative plants.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even exhibition illumination, pastel ambient glow, showroom clarity, polished 3D brand-space realism
